items.title: 4 Stocks Analysts and Hedge Funds Surprisingly Prefer Over Tesla
items.summary: Tesla keeps winning the headlines while its core profits shrink and its stock trades at a staggering multiple. Meanwhile, four quieter companies powering AI, advertising, and space are earning something Tesla can't: near-unanimous backing from the analysts and funds that watch them.

items.title: AppLovin Just Gained 45% in a Month. What Will It Take to Hit $500?
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAppLovin (APP:NASDAQ) stock is up 45% in the past month on 55% Q3 revenue growth and a Q4 guide above estimates. Gaming grew nearly 50%, so Roblox’s (RBLX:NYSE) user slump looks like its own problem, though Unity Software’s (U:NYSE) ad engine is growing even faster.

items.title: AppLovin in talks to acquire ad-tech peer Criteo, Reuters reports
items.summary: Investing.com -- Applovin Corp (NASDAQ:APP) is among the prospective buyers in discussions to acquire smaller Paris-based advertising technology peer Criteo Sa ADR (NASDAQ:CRTO), according to a Reuters report citing two people familiar with the matter. The potential deal highlights ongoing consolidation across the digital advertising sector as larger software platforms look to expand their reach.
